title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 18 · Gandhari shows Krishna the Kaurava dead

summary.en: Gandhari shows Krishna the hundred sons killed by Bhima's mace and the vulture-eaten bodies of her children. She points to Duhshasana's body, from which Bhima drank blood, and curses her own fate.
summary.kn: ಗಾಂಧಾರಿ ಭೀಮನ ಗದೆಯಿಂದ ಹತರಾದ ನೂರು ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು, ರಣಹದ್ದು ತಿಂದ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ದೇಹಗಳನ್ನು ಕೃಷ್ಣನಿಗೆ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಭೀಮ ರಕ್ತ ಕುಡಿದ ದುಃಶಾಸನನ ದೇಹ ತೋರಿಸಿ ತನ್ನ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನು ಶಪಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: गान्धारी कृष्ण को भीम की गदा से मारे गए सौ पुत्र और गिद्धों से खाए बच्चों के शरीर दिखाती हैं। वे दुःशासन का शव दिखाती हैं जिसका रक्त भीम ने पिया, और अपने भाग्य को कोसती हैं।
summary.te: గాంధారి భీముని గదచే చనిపోయిన వంద మంది కొడుకులను, గద్దలు తిన్న పిల్లల శరీరాలను కృష్ణునికి చూపుతుంది. భీముడు రక్తం తాగిన దుశ్శాసనుని శరీరాన్ని చూపి తన విధిని శపిస్తుంది.
summary.ta: காந்தாரி பீமனின் கதையால் கொல்லப்பட்ட நூறு மக்களையும் கழுகுகள் தின்ற குழந்தைகளின் உடல்களையும் கண்ணனுக்குக் காட்டுகிறாள். பீமன் இரத்தம் குடித்த துச்சாசனனின் உடலைக் காட்டித் தன் விதியைச் சபிக்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: ഭീമന്റെ ഗദയാൽ വീണ നൂറു പുത്രന്മാരെ ഗാന്ധാരി കൃഷ്ണനെ കാണിക്കുന്നു; കഴുകന്മാർ തിന്ന തന്റെ മക്കളുടെ ശരീരങ്ങളും കാണിക്കുന്നു. ഭീമൻ രക്തം കുടിച്ച ദുശ്ശാസനന്റെ ശരീരം ചൂണ്ടിക്കാട്ടി, അവൾ സ്വന്തം വിധിയെ ശപിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 11.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 17 2017

verses.text: गान्धार्युवाच

meaning.en: Gandhari said:

verses.text:
पश्य माधव पुत्रान्मे शतसंख्याञ्जितक्लमान् ।
गदया भीमसेनेन भूयिष्ठं निहतान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Look, Madhava, at my hundred sons who had conquered weariness, most of them struck down in battle by Bhimasena with his mace.

verses.text:
इदं दुःखतरं मेऽद्य यदिमा मुक्तमूर्धजाः ।
हतपुत्रा रणे बालाः परिधावन्ति मे स्नुषाः ॥

meaning.en: This is a harder grief to me today, that these young daughters-in-law of mine, their sons slain, run about in the battle with loosened hair.

verses.text:
प्रासादतलचारिण्यश्चरणैर्भूषणान्वितैः ।
आपन्ना यत्स्पृशन्तीमा रुधिरार्द्रां वसुंधराम् ॥

meaning.en: Women who once walked on palace floors with ornamented feet now, in distress, touch the blood-wet earth.

verses.text:
गृध्रानुत्सारयन्त्यश्च गोमायून्वायसांस्तथा ।
शोकेनार्ता विघूर्णन्त्यो मत्ता इव चरन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: Driving off vultures, jackals and crows, afflicted by grief, reeling, they wander about as if drunk.

verses.text:
एषान्या त्वनवद्याङ्गी करसंमितमध्यमा ।
घोरं तद्वैशसं दृष्ट्वा निपतत्यतिदुःखिता ॥

meaning.en: Here is another, blameless in her limbs, her waist small enough to be clasped by a hand; seeing that terrible slaughter, she falls down in great grief.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा मे पार्थिवसुतामेतां लक्ष्मणमातरम् ।
राजपुत्रीं महाबाहो मनो न व्युपशाम्यति ॥

meaning.en: Seeing this princess, mother of Lakshmana, my mind does not grow calm, mighty-armed one.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄंश्चान्याः पतींश्चान्याः पुत्रांश्च निहतान्भुवि ।
दृष्ट्वा परिपतन्त्येताः प्रगृह्य सुभुजा भुजान् ॥

meaning.en: Some women, seeing brothers, others husbands, others sons slain on the ground, rush around and seize their arms with their own fair arms.

verses.text:
मध्यमानां तु नारीणां वृद्धानां चापराजित ।
आक्रन्दं हतबन्धूनां दारुणे वैशसे शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Unconquered one, hear in this dreadful slaughter the wailing of the middle-aged and elderly women whose kin are dead.

verses.text:
रथनीडानि देहांश्च हतानां गजवाजिनाम् ।
आश्रिताः श्रममोहार्ताः स्थिताः पश्य महाबल ॥

meaning.en: Mighty one, look how, exhausted and bewildered, they stand taking shelter by chariot-seats and the bodies of the slain elephants and horses.

verses.text:
अन्या चापहृतं कायाच्चारुकुण्डलमुन्नसम् ।
स्वस्य बन्धोः शिरः कृष्ण गृहीत्वा पश्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, look at another woman standing holding the head of her own kinsman, with its beautiful earrings and fine nose, taken from his body.

verses.text:
पूर्वजातिकृतं पापं मन्ये नाल्पमिवानघ ।
एताभिरनवद्याभिर्मया चैवाल्पमेधया ॥

meaning.en: Blameless one, I think the sin committed in a former life by these blameless women and by me, of little understanding, was not small.

verses.text:
तदिदं धर्मराजेन यातितं नो जनार्दन ।
न हि नाशोऽस्ति वार्ष्णेय कर्मणोः शुभपापयोः ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, Dharmaraja strove to prevent this for us, but there is no loss, Vrishni, of deeds good and bad.

verses.text:
प्रत्यग्रवयसः पश्य दर्शनीयकुचोदराः ।
कुलेषु जाता ह्रीमत्यः कृष्णपक्षाक्षिमूर्धजाः ॥

meaning.en: Look at these young women, with lovely breasts and waists, born in good families, modest, with dark-edged eyes and hair,

verses.text:
हंसगद्गदभाषिण्यो दुःखशोकप्रमोहिताः ।
सारस्य इव वाशन्त्यः पतिताः पश्य माधव ॥

meaning.en: speaking in voices thick like geese, bewildered by grief and sorrow, fallen and crying like cranes, Madhava.

verses.text:
फुल्लपद्मप्रकाशानि पुण्डरीकाक्ष योषिताम् ।
अनवद्यानि वक्त्राणि तपत्यसुखरश्मिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Lotus-eyed one, the faultless faces of these women, bright as blossomed lotuses, are scorched by the unpleasant sun.

verses.text:
ईर्षूणां मम पुत्राणां वासुदेवावरोधनम् ।
मत्तमातङ्गदर्पाणां पश्यन्त्यद्य पृथग्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Vasudeva, common people see today the women's quarters of my jealous sons, proud as rutting elephants.

verses.text:
शतचन्द्राणि चर्माणि ध्वजांश्चादित्यसंनिभान् ।
रौक्माणि चैव वर्माणि निष्कानपि च काञ्चनान् ॥

meaning.en: On the ground are my sons' shields with a hundred moons, their banners bright as the sun, their golden armor and golden necklaces,

verses.text:
शीर्षत्राणानि चैतानि पुत्राणां मे महीतले ।
पश्य दीप्तानि गोविन्द पावकान्सुहुतानिव ॥

meaning.en: and their helmets, Govinda; look, they shine like fires well fed with offerings.

verses.text:
एष दुःशासनः शेते शूरेणामित्रघातिना ।
पीतशोणितसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनेन पातितः ॥

meaning.en: Here lies Duhshasana, felled by the hero who slays his enemies, Bhimasena, every limb of whom had drunk blood.

verses.text:
गदया वीरघातिन्या पश्य माधव मे सुतम् ।
द्यूतक्लेशाननुस्मृत्य द्रौपद्या चोदितेन च ॥

meaning.en: Look, Madhava, at my son, killed by the hero-slaying mace, remembering the torments of the dice game and urged on by Draupadi.

verses.text:
उक्ता ह्यनेन पाञ्चाली सभायां द्यूतनिर्जिता ।
प्रियं चिकीर्षता भ्रातुः कर्णस्य च जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to please his brother and Karna, he said in the assembly to Panchali, who had been won at dice:

verses.text:
सहैव सहदेवेन नकुलेनार्जुनेन च ।
दासभार्यासि पाञ्चालि क्षिप्रं प्रविश नो गृहान् ॥

meaning.en: "Panchali, you are a slave's wife, together with Sahadeva, Nakula and Arjuna. Quickly enter our house."

verses.text:
ततोऽहमब्रुवं कृष्ण तदा दुर्योधनं नृपम् ।
मृत्युपाशपरिक्षिप्तं शकुनिं पुत्र वर्जय ॥

meaning.en: Then, Krishna, I told King Duryodhana: "Son, give up Shakuni, who is wrapped in the noose of death.

verses.text:
निबोधैनं सुदुर्बुद्धिं मातुलं कलहप्रियम् ।
क्षिप्रमेनं परित्यज्य पुत्र शाम्यस्व पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: Know him as an evil-minded uncle who loves quarrels. Quickly abandon him, son, and make peace with the Pandavas.

verses.text:
न बुध्यसे त्वं दुर्बुद्धे भीमसेनममर्षणम् ।
वाङ्नाराचैस्तुदंस्तीक्ष्णैरुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥

meaning.en: You do not understand, foolish one, that Bhimasena is intolerant, and you torment him with sharp arrows of words as one torments an elephant with torches."

verses.text:
तानेष रभसः क्रूरो वाक्शल्यानवधारयन् ।
उत्ससर्ज विषं तेषु सर्पो गोवृषभेष्विव ॥

meaning.en: That fierce, impetuous man, taking those thorns of words to heart, released his poison on them, as a serpent on bulls and cows.

verses.text:
एष दुःशासनः शेते विक्षिप्य विपुलौ भुजौ ।
निहतो भीमसेनेन सिंहेनेव महर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: Here lies Duhshasana, arms flung wide, killed by Bhimasena like a great bull by a lion.

verses.text:
अत्यर्थमकरोद्रौद्रं भीमसेनोऽत्यमर्षणः ।
दुःशासनस्य यत्क्रुद्धोऽपिबच्छोणितमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, in his great anger, did something exceedingly savage, that in his rage he drank Duhshasana's blood in battle.
